plugins.name: roadmap
plugins.description: Roadmap + backlog graph with a work profile. Engineering (default): the GitHub-first Gauntlet Loop — /gauntlet conducts frozen-bar implementation, independent exact-SHA criticism, frozen-lead acknowledgment, repair and fresh re-criticism; /fanout is cross-slice concurrency; /sync reconciles merged PRs. General (meta.profile: general): the same rituals on document artifacts — /assign, /conduct, /sync. The graph MCP registers core tools plus the loaded profile's (gauntlet_* or conduct_*).
